name: vanuikit
description: VanUikit monorepo: the VanJS component library + demo app. Each package builds and publishes separately.

scripts.build:min: npm run build --workspace vanuikit && npm run build:min --workspace demo
scripts.lint: cd vanuikit && bun run typecheck && cd ../demo && bun run typecheck && cd .. && bun run i18n:check && bun run i18n:scan -- --check && bun run check:spell
